section.title: Introduction
section.para: Dependency parsing assigns each token a syntactic head and a relation label. DependencyParserME accepts tokens with aligned part-of-speech tags and returns a DependencyGraph using a maximum entropy model.

section.title: Training data
section.para: ConlluDependencySampleStream reads the basic HEAD and DEPREL columns of a CoNLL-U treebank. Select ConlluTagset.U for universal tags or ConlluTagset.X for language-specific tags. The reader retains syntactic words from multiword tokens and skips sentences without a complete dependency tree or the selected POS tags.

section.title: Maximum entropy parser
Command-line tools
section.para: Training, evaluation, and cross validation read UTF-8 CoNLL-U files. Use -tagset u (the default) for UPOS or -tagset x for XPOS. Use the same tagset for training and inference. An optional -params file supplies the standard training parameters, and -factory names a DependencyParserFactory extension. For example:
section.programlisting: opennlp DependencyParserTrainerME.conllu -lang eng -data train.conllu -model en-depparse.bin opennlp DependencyParserEvaluator.conllu -model en-depparse.bin -data dev.conllu opennlp DependencyParserCrossValidator.conllu -lang eng -data train.conllu -folds 5 opennlp DependencyParserME en-depparse.bin < tagged-sentences.txt
section.para: Inference reads one sentence per line in the POS tagger's token_TAG format, for example dogs_NOUN run_VERB. It writes ten-column CoNLL-U output with one-based heads and 0 for the root. Input tags are retained in XPOS; UPOS and other unavailable annotations are _. The evaluation and cross-validation tools report UAS and LAS over all scored tokens.

section.title: Feedforward parser
section.para: Scoring uses double precision for input products and cached contributions. Cached and direct scoring produce the same values. The shared cache retains at most 32,768 template-position and embedding-row pairs; other pairs use direct calculation. Greedy and beam parsing throw IllegalStateException if the model produces a non-finite transition score.
